doc.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Who played and sang that night
summary: Williams and Hinton sort out the lineup, with Jim Hall, Clark Terry and Dizzy Gillespie in the audience, and Williams singing.

blocks.x: And Dizzy Gillespie was just in the audience. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
Yeah. He wasn’t even on the stage. Clark Terry.
Clark Terry and Al Hall on guitar. Al, what’s his name on guitar?
Jim Hall. It was a most auspicious night. It was auspicious because you got up and sang that —
Oh, yeah but you were shocked, Tom Whaley. Tom said, “You want me to conduct?” I said, “You made the arrangements, why don’t you conduct it?” Oh, man.
